Enter the door on the left now to find a file you can read through. It has several pages. You can also hack the computer in the corner. You need to input symbols in this one. Return and to the north is another locked door we need to hack. The bottom ring is already in place so don't touch it. We want to start by moving the third ring one spot to the right of the center. Now move the top ring one spot to the left of the center. Go ahead and move the third ring to the center and this will move the top ring also to the center. Now simply move the second ring to the center and you'll open the door. In here you can find a single chest that has Mystite, but you'll need an Advanced Cryptokey to open it. Return and go right to find a chest with Flashover Chip and Digitalin. Go ahead and equip the chip on your main weapon. You'll need it in a bit. Afterwards, check the little sparkle on the shelf to find Photo of an Apartment. If you look closely, this is the apartment in Margaritia, where we found a Cyber Neko+, in the northeastern corner of the city.
